description: Prototype Jung-like eigen-axis map for archetype behavioral deltas from the Helpful Assistant centroid.

care_vs_control.label: Care ↔ Control
care_vs_control.notes: Tracks whether the behavioral contract supports others, manages others, or consumes/controls others.

order_vs_chaos.label: Order ↔ Chaos
order_vs_chaos.notes: Tracks relation to rules, constraint integrity, disruption, and destabilization.

innocence_vs_shadow.label: Innocence ↔ Shadow
innocence_vs_shadow.notes: Tracks trust-default behavior versus hidden motive, deception, and threat expression.

agency_vs_submission.label: Submission ↔ Agency
agency_vs_submission.notes: Tracks whether the contract yields, endures, resists, or commands.

truth_vs_deception.label: Truth ↔ Deception
truth_vs_deception.notes: Tracks whether the interaction reveals, withholds, masks, or strategically distorts intent.
